Kunal Prayag Singh @ Dheeraj Singh vs State Of U.P. on 16
December, 2023
Author: Krishan Pahal

Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:238594
Court No. - 72
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13580 of 2023

Applicant :- Kunal Prayag Singh @ Dheeraj Singh
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Vandana Gupta,Ashutosh Gupta Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Ashutosh Gupta, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ashutosh Srivastava, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No.258 of 2022, registered under Sections 419, 420 I.P.C. at Police Station- Sadar Bazar, District- Kunal Prayag Singh @ Dheeraj Singh vs State Of U.P. on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145249603/
1 Mathura with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Kunal Prayag Singh @ Dheeraj Singh vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. As per prosecution story, the applicant is stated to have acted as imposter and projected himself to be commando in NSG and had duped the informant and friend of him to the tune of Rs.2,50,000/- each.
The said amount was transferred to certain accounts through UPI.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is a bona fide person and has no criminal antecedents to his credit.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
The applicant has apprehension of his arrest.

Learned counsel has stated that the applicant undertakes that he has co-operated in the investigation and is ready to do so in trial also failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.
6.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail application on the ground that the applicant has opened a Facebook account by showing himself to be an NSG commando, thus he is not entitled for anticipatory bail.

7. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant, the applicant is liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicant shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

entities.text: Kunal Prayag Singh @ Dheeraj Singh vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.

Order Date :- 16.12.2023 Vikas [Krishan Pahal, J.]
